name: Grajera (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a blue saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Grajera (a pillory on blue).
history: Grajera adopted its arms and flag officially on 4 April 2008, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 17 September 2008; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1:1, white, with a blue saltire whose arms are 1/8 of the width, and the municipal arms in its colours superimposed at the centre.

features.role: saltire with arms of 1/8 of the width
cap of the crown of the arms
